question: A policeman follows a thief 1800 metres ahead of him. If the policeman and the thief run at a speed of 12 km/h and 9 km/h, respectively, how much distance thief will cover from spotting point (1800 meters ahead to policeman) before catch by policeman?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed ratio of Policeman to Thief = 12 : 9 = 4 : 3

Since the time taken to meet is constant, Distance ratio = 4 : 3

Difference in distance ratio = 4 − 3 = 1 unit

Here, 1 unit = 1800 m (initial separation distance)

Distance covered by thief = 3 units = 3 × 1800 = 5400 metres

**∴ The correct answer is 5400 metres.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00c94c6b3651cd47ebd5b46513b645f0605a6d0f8a4617d3fc45db9653707878.png] 

**Given:**

Speed of Policeman (Sₚ) = 12 km/h

Speed of Thief (Sₜ) = 9 km/h

Initial separation distance (d) = 1800 m = 1.8 km

**Formula Used:**

Relative Speed (same direction) = S₁ − S₂

Time = Distance ÷ Relative Speed

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculations:**

⇒ Relative speed = Sₚ − Sₜ = 12 − 9 = 3 km/h

⇒ Time taken to catch the thief = Distance ÷ Relative speed = 1.8 ÷ 3 = 0.6 hours

⇒ Distance covered by thief = Sₜ × Time taken

⇒ Distance covered by thief = 9 × 0.6 = 5.4 km

⇒ Distance in metres = 5.4 × 1000 = 5400 metres

**∴ The correct answer is 5400 metres.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed (Same Direction)

When two objects move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference between their individual speeds: Sᵣₑₗ = |S₁ − S₂|.

Relative Speed (Opposite Direction)

When two objects move towards each other in opposite directions, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds: Sᵣₑₗ = S₁ + S₂.

Speed Unit Conversion

To convert km/h to m/s, multiply the speed value by 5 ÷ 18. To convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18 ÷ 5.
